executiveSummary: Two major earthquakes produced mass casualties and urban collapse in Western Colombia (≥287 fatalities reported; entrapment persists) and on Indonesia's Flores Island (≥54 fatalities; thousands awaiting aid). View Article Supporting Report Record river flooding in Indiana caused at least seven deaths, severe damage to roads/bridges, and large power outages; shelters and rescues continued statewide. View Article Fast-moving wildfires in British Columbia displaced more than 20,000 people and caused at least one death; returns remain unsafe in several communities. View Article Severe drought in southwestern Somalia is driving displacement and emergency food insecurity affecting around 2 million people; aid shortfalls persist. View Article A tropical storm system swept roughly 100 homes off foundations on Hawai'i Island, triggering search-and-rescue operations; no deaths immediately reported. View Article Typhoon-related flooding and landslides disrupted transport across eastern China and northern Luzon; millions affected and relocations mounted. View Article Note: Some casualty and impact figures vary by source and are evolving as assessments continue.

keyFindings.title: Western Colombia
keyFindings.summary: Large-scale building collapse with ongoing entrapment days after the quake; initial missing-persons figures were high, and international SAR was mobilized. View Article

keyFindings.title: Indonesia (Flores)

outlook72h: Colombia Earthquake: SAR window remains open but narrowing; anticipate additional recoveries and rising confirmed tolls as access improves. Urban safety cordons likely to expand pending structural assessments. Source Indonesia (Flores) Earthquake: Aftershocks possible; priority on medical evacuation, WASH, shelter, and last-mile distribution to remote villages. Source Indiana Flooding: Gradual recession on some rivers; expect ongoing sheltering, debris removal, and infrastructure inspections; fatality counts may update as assessments proceed. Source British Columbia Wildfires: Weather-driven flare-ups remain possible; additional evacuation alerts or orders may occur with wind shifts and terrain-driven spread. Source East Asia Tropical Impacts: Continued cleanup and residual flooding/landslide risk; transport normalization will be phased as safety checks complete. Source Somalia Drought: No short-term relief expected; monitor malnutrition admissions and water trucking capacity at displacement sites. Source
